description: [roadmap S2.9] Held pixels: a pixel of a dialog rectangle is judged only when three probe backgrounds (0x0000, 0x7fff, a pseudo-random pattern) and the run without a probe give the same word. A body that wrongly ignores the destination is caught (the pixel is then judged and differs); a body that wrongly reads the destination where the original does not makes its pixels held and they are not judged. Held counts per rectangle are 9..32 for the popups and text boxes (border blend and corners) and 28,578 for the grading page (its drawAlpha pass and transparent parts)
needed: S3 (the course drawn under the dialogs), after which held pixels are judged like the others
